policy: new complexity must buy deletion, compression, or auditability

evolution_budget.shared_store: One canonical state and one derived graph serve all six capabilities.
evolution_budget.compression: Reuse the Issue parser and five agents; derived indexes replace duplicate manually maintained context summaries.

ingestion_budget.compression: Reuse the existing ledger and contradiction catalog; collapse identical Issue deliveries into one revision.
ingestion_budget.recording_policy: One source snapshot and one trace per revision; no copied user profile or comments.
